author: Stahly
description:
Squidmar Miniatures have just launched their own paint range. At Spiel in Essen, I interviewed Emil, Lukas and Jaume from Vallejo about what sets these paints apart from the existing Game and Model Colors. And then, I tested them all at home in my studio. Does Squidmar Color have everything you need to help you become a better painter, or is it all just a hobby scam cash grab? I'll tell you in this review

The post Squidmar Color review: did we really need another Vallejo paint range? appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Squidmar Color review: did we really need another Vallejo paint range?
